description: This file contains stub functions that redirect gettext functions to the GNU libintl library, facilitating compatibility and logging features across different library versions and systems.

methods.name: gettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_gettext for message translation.

methods.name: dgettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dgettext for domain-specific message translation.

methods.name: dcgettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dcgettext for category-specific message translation.

methods.name: ngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_ngettext for plural message translation.

methods.name: dngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dngettext for domain-specific plural message translation.

methods.name: dcngettext
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_dcngettext for category-specific plural message translation.

methods.name: textdomain
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_textdomain to set or get the current domain.

methods.name: bindtextdomain
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_bindtextdomain to set the directory for a domain.

methods.name: bind_textdomain_codeset
methods.description: Redirects to libintl_bind_textdomain_codeset to set the codeset for a domain.
